{{Top|leg}}
'''Max''' was [[Thurm Loogg]]'s personal assistant during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. This individual was responsible for writing and teleprompting the speeches Loogg delivered to the people of [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]]. If Loog misspoke or said something deemed to be offensive, he blamed Max.
